Kidney Stones

Ailment kidney-stones nephrolithiasis renal-calcification pain urinary-tract

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Hard deposits of minerals and salts that form inside the kidneys and can cause severe pain when passing through the urinary tract.

Symptoms

  • sudden severe flank pain
  • blood in urine
  • frequent urination
  • painful urination
  • nausea
  • vomiting
  • suprapubic pain

Remedies for This Condition

  • Celery Seed
    Natural diuretic that helps reduce fluid retention and uric acid buildup, beneficial for edema and gout.
  • Hydrangea Root
    Traditional herb used to support kidney and bladder function, helpful for fluid retention.
  • Parsley
    Natural diuretic rich in potassium and vitamins that reduces fluid retention while maintaining electrolyte balance.
  • Corn Silk
    Gentle diuretic and kidney tonic that specifically supports urinary tract health, reducing inflammation and promoting urine flow.
  • Goldenrod
    Anti-inflammatory herb that supports urinary tract and kidney function, helpful for UTIs and kidney stone prevention.

Affected Body Systems

  • renal
  • urinary
  • circulatory

Severity Levels

  • mild
  • moderate
  • severe
